criteria.text: Command registers on the Commander program — `sfdt retrofit --help` exits 0.

Package-internal path resolution — src/commands/retrofit.js resolves its shell script via path.join(config._projectRoot, 'scripts/ops/retrofit.sh'). CLAUDE.md requires import.meta.url for any path inside the sfdt package; _projectRoot points at the user's Salesforce project when globally installed, so this throws ENOENT on every machine but the author's. SYNTHETIC ROW — H-013 self-improvement drill, not a real verdict.
Template is read and deep-merged as specified.

Package-internal path resolution — src/lib/ci-templates.js reads scripts/ci/partials/ via path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scripts/ci/partials'). CLAUDE.md's "Package-Internal Path Resolution — CRITICAL RULE" requires import.meta.url; a CWD-relative read resolves against the user's project and breaks `sfdt ci init` for every globally installed user. SYNTHETIC ROW — H-013 self-improvement drill, not a real verdict.
Catalogs regenerated — npm run check:catalogs clean.

Package-internal path resolution — src/lib/doc-generator.js locates its MkDocs template with path.join(config._projectRoot, 'src/templates/mkdocs.yml'). Third occurrence of the same class this cycle: package assets addressed from _projectRoot / process.cwd() instead of import.meta.url. CLAUDE.md documents the rule and says to run /validate-npm-paths before every release, but nothing in tools/ checks it — the rule is enforced only by a human remembering to run a slash command. SYNTHETIC ROW — H-013 self-improvement drill, not a real verdict.
Role guides emit under docs/guides/<type>/<component>/<role>.md as specified.
